title: Flappy Bird
description: Classic arcade bird game with custom skins and worlds shop.

title: Knockout Night
description: 3D boxing with combos, parry, super and online 1v1 with friends.

title: Battleship
description: 3D top-down battleship. Drag your ships into place, then sink the enemy fleet vs the computer or online with a friend.

title: Stratego
description: 3D Stratego with hidden ranks, spies, miners and bombs. Deploy forty pieces, capture the flag, or play online with a friend.

title: Kryds & Bolle 3D
description: Gold X and O pieces on black marble. Beat the computer or a friend — three in a row wins.

title: Sky Hop 3D
description: Small 3D collect-a-thon: hop across floating islands, double jump and grab all eight stars. A love letter to the 3D platformers of the late 90s.

title: Brick Blast
description: Break every brick, catch the falling capsules and keep the ball alive. Wide paddle, extra balls and slow motion power-ups.

title: Star Swarm
description: A formation of pixel invaders marches down while you hold the line behind crumbling bunkers. Endless waves and a bonus saucer.

title: River Hop
description: Five lanes of traffic, a river of drifting logs and five lily pads to reach. One hop at a time, sixty seconds on the clock.

title: Maze Munch
description: Chomp every dot in a freshly generated maze while three bugs hunt you. Grab a power pellet and turn the hunt around.

title: Catan
description: 3D Catan on a full island: settle, trade with the bank or your rivals, build roads and cities, and race three computer players to ten points.

title: Chess
description: 3D chess on a wooden set. Play the computer, or invite a friend with a code and play live.

title: Star Clicker
description: Click your star, grow it and add orbiting planets.

title: Hedgerow Hallow
description: Guard the veggie patch from snails, beetles and one very rude badger.
